coverage: England and Wales; registered freehold property subset
identifier_semantics: Unique identification number for each INSPIRE Index Polygon; relates to a registered title.
limitations: INSPIRE polygons show indicative position and extent; they do not establish the legal extent of a registered title.
The dataset is a subset for freehold registered property and does not represent all tenures.
No local canonical parcel identifier or building-presence join is available on this page.
No parcel-to-Environment-Agency DEM/LIDAR tile intersection or elevation statistics are computed here.
update_frequency: first Sunday of each month; published data reflects the previous month
